title: Coast cleanup: DEM land outside NE polygons joins nearest country or becomes sea
body: 1:50m polygons and DEM disagree at coasts; BFS up to 4 cells assigns stray DEM land to nearest country, rest lowered to sea. Country cells forced >= 3 m (polders). Use ADM0_A3 not ISO_A3 (FRA/NOR are -99 in ISO_A3).

title: User wants work split across multiple agents
body: User asked to 'arbeite mit mehreren agents'. Pattern that worked: lead writes shared contracts (src/core/types.ts, EventBus, GeoData) first, then parallel agents with strict file ownership and exact public APIs; lead integrates main.ts and tests in browser.

title: Logarithmic depth buffer is on; custom ShaderMaterials need logdepthbuf chunks
body: GameRenderer enables logarithmicDepthBuffer to avoid coast z-fighting across 1 km..20000 km range. Any new ShaderMaterial must include logdepthbuf_pars/vertex/fragment chunks or depth sorting vs terrain breaks.

title: Project built in phases; wait for user feedback after each phase
body: User's spec defines 10 phases (1 map/camera/menu, 2 OSM roads+units, 3 combat, 4 civilians, 5 economy, 6 trade, 7 politics, 8 seasons, 9 multiplayer, 10 research/AI). Deliver one phase, then stop for feedback. UI text and commit messages in German.

title: Player country keeps its map color (no blue tint)
body: A steel-blue player tint made the player's country look like water. Player is marked only by light-blue edge + slight brightness lift.

title: Headless WebGL test needs SwiftShader flags
body: Playwright chromium.launch args: --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader. Test against 'npx vite preview'. Scope menu selectors to #ui (map labels share country names). Don't 'pkill -f vite' in the same command as git - it kills the shell.

title: Raster asset encodings
body: heights.png: 16-bit gray, value = meters + 12000 (sea quantized to 25 m). countries.png: RGB8, R = country id (0 sea, max 249), G = water flags 1 lake / 2 river. Decoded in browser with fast-png (canvas would lose 16-bit precision).

title: Edge scroll only after real pointermove
body: Headless/real Chromium can fire synthetic pointerenter at (0,0) on load, which triggered edge scrolling and drifted camera to NW corner. mouse.inside is set only on pointermove/pointerdown, not pointerenter.

title: World coords: 1 unit = 1 km, X east, Z south, origin NW map corner
body: Y = heightKm * settings.heightExaggeration (default 6), sea surface y=0. Texture UV u=x/widthKm, v=z/heightKm, raster row 0 = north. Projection is spherical LAEA centered 52N/10E (like EPSG:3035).

title: Geodata pipeline uses curl, not Node fetch
body: scripts/build-geodata.mjs downloads via curl because Node's fetch ignores HTTPS_PROXY in the sandbox. Natural Earth 50m + AWS Terrarium tiles z6, cached in scripts/.cache (gitignored). Outputs in public/data are committed so users need no download.
